what: judo fill --pages table added unrequested DataColumns (description and priceLabel) and changed dataFeature on them. The builder had to delete the description column by hand.

what: Model CLI element names and paths were guessed repeatedly: query ui MenuItem, Access, PageDefinition title, GraphQL menuItems and _type fields, and FQNs with the id: prefix all failed with 'does not exist' or 'element not found' before the right names were found.

what: judo move --dry-run printed the reordered element as 'changed ... description (in components)' rather than the element being moved, so the dry-run output was misread while reordering the form fields. The builder then ran discard --force to clear unsaved reorders.

what: CLI query of TwoWayRelationMember failed: asking for field partner without a sub-selection returns SubselectionRequired.

what: ./judo.sh schema-upgrade failed with Non-readable POM for the schema directory; with -o schema_dir=application it ran for 900 seconds and timed out.
why: The schema-upgrade step expects a schema module directory and a running persistent DB; the default layout did not match this project and the run hung.
workaround: Killed the run and reset the database volumes instead of upgrading.

Failure is expected when no persistent DB; the 900 s hang is unexplained. Add the schema_dir option and precondition to build-process.md; ticket the Non-readable POM default only if reproduced.

what: The Round 7 model script applied many CLI edits in one run with no check between steps; a partial run left unsaved edits, so the builder discarded them and reran the script.

note: judo-cli.md "Known limitations" already says a failed script leaves earlier edits in memory and to discard --force before retrying, and documents --no-check. Builder did not apply it; retrieval problem only.

what: ctx_execute ran with /bin/sh and failed on bash process substitution syntax.

what: judo-cli.jar was missing from target/ after generate and build steps, so CLI calls failed with Unable to access jarfile; the builder had to run generate-root to restore it.

what: The CLI query for DataColumn and DataFilter returned nothing until 'fill' had been run on the transfer object, so the builder first thought the table columns did not exist.

what: postCallAccessNavigation cannot be cleared once set, and move --index had no effect on the position of the action group; move --after did reorder the menu entries.

what: judo-cli query esm with --where fqn=... returns nothing, and --select dataType{name} or dataType.name is rejected (scalar fields only), so the builder decompiled and grepped generated code to learn names.
